svg.title: FinoraOS C4 system design
svg.desc: C4-style architecture showing FinoraOS actors, external systems, web and API containers, controlled agents, deterministic engines, PostgreSQL identities, tenant isolation, operational flows and reconciliation evaluation.

g.text: C4 container + component view · current V1 implementation · Razorpay AI Buildathon Track 04
Deterministic verification · controlled AI · governed action
82 tests · production build · no paid AI
Verify JWT issuer/audience → resolve subject + organization to database membership and role
Grounded answers · no Prisma or SQL
Hard ancestor limits · soft category warnings
Transaction-local app.organization_id · absent context returns no rows

svg.text: Prisma application identity + controlled agent database roles

g.text: Chat → FinanceAgent → Zod tool → permission check → agent_ro → RLS → PostgreSQL → grounded artifact
Scoped records → pure engine → matches + exceptions + metrics → Prisma transaction → audit event
Write mode → typed diff → human approval → agent_rw → version check + RLS → audit → reconciliation rerun

svg.text: OFFLINE VERIFICATION · EXACT SAME PURE ENGINE AS THE API · NO OLLAMA OR PAID API

g.text: 108 correct matches · 12 honest exceptions · 0 false auto-matches · 100% match accuracy
Model boundary: no SQL · no credentials · no direct mutation authority
